- No render refusals.. Judge: B wins three of the four pairs, two of them by a wide margin (pairs 2 and 4). Only pair 1 goes to A, and only narrowly. All four A frames come from the same HUD-bearing build set on a Singapore-style shophouse street. That build is strong where it is strongest: warm, believable low-sun lighting, atmospheric depth on the skyline, and richly dressed facades that give a real sense of place. That is enough to beat B in pair 1, a dated, heavily green-graded wind-farm still with a blown-out sky and a crushed hero car. The same A frames repeat the same tells, though. Hero cars have murky, smeared reflections and blooming tail lights. The median plants are blocky and faceted every time. Streets are nearly empty, with no or static pedestrians and little traffic. There are white sparkle artifacts, a near-black road in the sunny pair 4 frame, a blank-grid placeholder minimap and cluttered prompts. The B frames win on crisp, readable car materials, visible life (traffic, pursuers, pedestrians) and deliberate cinematic composition, and the B frames in pairs 2 and 4 are genuine showpieces. The highest-leverage fixes for the A build, in order: hero-car material and readability, street population at junctions, and road-surface albedo/lighting, followed by replacing the low-poly median foliage and the placeholder HUD.
